statements.t: At the same time, we continued to advance (Z)-endoxifen toward several near-term milestones, including anticipated FDA clearance of our IND applications in Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy and McCune-Albright Syndrome in early 2027.
The Company anticipates Investigational New Drug (IND) application clearance from the FDA for (Z)-endoxifen in MAS and DMD by early 2027, with initiation of Phase 2 clinical trials expected in 2027.

The Company anticipates topline data from the Phase 2 EVANGELINE study of (Z)-endoxifen plus goserelin as neoadjuvant therapy in premenopausal women with ER+/HER2- breast cancer in the second quarter of 2027.
The Company’s proprietary oral formulation has shown a favorable safety profile and pharmacology distinct from tamoxifen, including ER-targeted effects and PKC inhibition.
